messages:
maggie: Quick sync — deciding next model admissions for the catalog. Sales is pushing Falcon-180B int8 for low-latency chat; infra prefers a quantized Mistral variant for cost. We realistically have capacity to onboard one Dedicated-optimized build this quarter. Do we run strict RICE or bias toward direct customer signals for Q2 launches? Need a quick call + explicit launch criteria.

devin: Quick RICE back-of-envelope: impact=6, reach=8, confidence=0.6, effort=3 -> score ≈ (6*8*0.6)/3 = 9.6. Falcon int8 looks solid by score but infra ops risk (oom, perf cliffs) raises effort/confidence volatility.

ryan: Sales here — we have 2 named accounts waiting for a high-throughput low-latency variant. If Falcon is in catalog, we can close one pilot this quarter. That feels like +reach and real ARR motion. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

anya: From CS: 3 customers pinged last week asking for better latency/cost options for chat. Two are in renewal windows. Customer signal > noise on this one. Also want clear privacy/keys docs for Dedicated.

lee: Suggestion: hybrid rule — accept if (RICE >= 8) OR (>=2 committed customers + basic perf guardrails). That balances product-level impact with commercial pulls.

maggie: I like the hybrid rule. We should make launch criteria explicit though. Proposed minimums: p90 latency < 120ms on Dedicated with quantized build, end-to-end regression eval on our top-100 prompt set with no >5% quality delta vs baseline, docs + example terraform for Dedicated, and EU region availability.

devin: Add one infra requirement: a fallback routing policy in Redwood Console to auto-route to a compatible variant if mem/capacity issues detected. Also require basic OOM/resume test. Example snippet for routing policy we can reuse: 
```
route("/generate") {
  primary: falcon-180b-int8
  fallback: falcon-180b-16q
  threshold: 85% gpu_util
}
```

ryan: If we get the hybrid rule, sales will fast-track pilots and provide commit signals. We'll also ask customers to sign a short pilot T&Cs (1 pager).

anya: Also add logging hooks + opt-in prompt collection for quality monitoring and a named contact for pilot support. That keeps regressions visible.

maggie: Plan then: 1) run a short RICE calc + infra check (devin/lee), 2) secure 1 committed pilot or 2 interested customers (ryan/anya), 3) run canary against top-100 eval, 4) confirm perf SLOs, 5) doc + Dedicated terraform. If step 2 or RICE >=8 true, greenlight. I'll own admission doc and timeline.

devin: +1. I'll start perf smoke and write up the OOM/resume checklist. ETA EOD Wed.

lee: I'll formalize the RICE sheet and include sensitivity to confidence.

ryan: I'll push for one pilot with AcmeCorp and loop legal on pilot T&Cs.

deploy-bot: ticket created: INF-4823 — canary pipeline + perf smoke (assigned to devin, lee).

maggie: Great. I'll update the catalog admission PR with the hybrid rule and launch checklist, assign owners, and ping this thread when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
